translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Taiping Xingguo, Mengzheng ranked first among jinshi, was appointed vice director of the Directorate of Imperial Construction, and served as supervising prefect of Sheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 陛辭，有旨，民事有不便者，許騎置以聞，賜錢二十萬。

translations.literal: At audience on his departure there was an edict: where civil affairs were inconvenient, he was permitted to report by relay horse; he was granted two hundred thousand in cash.
translations.idiomatic: At his farewell audience the emperor decreed that wherever civil affairs were burdensome he might report by relay horse; he was also granted two hundred thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 代還，會征太原，召見行在，授著作郎、直史館，加左拾遺。

translations.literal: When his term ended and he returned, the Taiyuan campaign was underway; summoned to the imperial camp, he was appointed Master of Composition and given direct appointment in the Historiography Institute, with the additional title Left Eraser.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended he returned just as the Taiyuan campaign was underway; summoned to the imperial camp, he was made Master of Composition with direct appointment in the Historiography Institute and the additional title Left Eraser.

sentences.zh: 五年，親拜左補闕、知制誥。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was personally appointed Left Supplements and drafter of edicts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was personally appointed Left Supplements and drafter of edicts.

sentences.zh: 初，龜圖多內寵，與妻劉氏不睦，並蒙正出之，頗淪躓窘乏，劉誓不復嫁。

translations.literal: At first Qitu had many favorites among the women of the household and was on bad terms with his wife, Lady Liu; together they drove Mengzheng out, and he fell into much hardship and poverty; Liu vowed never to remarry.
translations.idiomatic: At first Qitu kept many concubines and was estranged from his wife, Lady Liu; together they drove Mengzheng out, and he fell into great hardship; Liu vowed never to remarry.

sentences.zh: 及蒙正登仕，迎二親，同堂異室，奉養備至。

translations.literal: When Mengzheng entered office he welcomed both parents; they lived under one roof in separate rooms, and he supported them with every care.
translations.idiomatic: Once Mengzheng entered office he brought both parents home; they lived under one roof in separate rooms, and he supported them with every care.

sentences.zh: 龜圖旋卒，詔起復。

translations.literal: Qitu soon died; an edict ordered that he resume office after mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Qitu soon died, and an edict ordered Mengzheng to resume office without completing mourning.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷都官郎中，入為翰林學士，擢左諫議大夫、參知政事，賜第麗景門。

translations.literal: Before long he was moved to director in the Ministry of Justice, entered as Hanlin academician, was promoted to Left Remonstrance and Reform Officer and Associate Chief Councilor, and was granted a mansion at Lijing Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he became director in the Ministry of Justice, entered service as Hanlin academician, was promoted to Left Remonstrance and Reform Officer and associate chief councilor, and was granted a mansion at Lijing Gate.

sentences.zh: 上謂之曰：「凡士未達，見當世之務戾於理者，則怏怏於心；

translations.literal: The emperor said to him: "When any gentleman has not yet risen, seeing affairs of the age that run against reason, he is discontent at heart;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to him, "Before a gentleman has risen, he is troubled whenever he sees the affairs of the age run against reason;

sentences.zh: 及列於位，得以獻可替否，當盡其所蘊，雖言未必盡中，亦當僉議而更之，俾協於道。

translations.literal: when ranked in office and able to offer approval or rejection, he should bring forth all he holds; even if his words do not entirely hit the mark, the court should discuss together and revise them, so that they accord with the Way.
translations.idiomatic: once in office and able to approve or reject policy, he should bring forth all he holds; even if his words are not wholly right, the court should discuss them together and revise them until they accord with the Way.

sentences.zh: 朕固不以崇高自恃，使人不敢言也。」

translations.literal: I by no means rely on my lofty station and so cause men not to dare speak."
translations.idiomatic: I do not rely on my lofty station to keep men from speaking."

sentences.zh: 蒙正初入朝堂，有朝士指之曰：「此子亦參政耶？」

translations.literal: When Mengzheng first entered the court hall, a court gentleman pointed at him and said: "This fellow is also chief councilor?"
translations.idiomatic: When Mengzheng first entered the court hall, a court gentleman pointed at him and said, "This fellow is also chief councilor?"

sentences.zh: 蒙正陽為不聞而過之，同列不能平，詰其姓名，蒙正遽止之曰：「若一知其姓名，則終身不能忘，不若毋知之為愈也。」

translations.literal: Mengzheng pretended not to hear and passed by; his colleagues could not contain their indignation and asked the man's name, but Mengzheng quickly stopped them, saying: "If I know his name even once, I shall never forget it for life; better not to know at all."
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng pretended not to hear and walked on; his colleagues, unable to contain their anger, asked the man's name, but Mengzheng quickly stopped them: "If I learn his name even once, I shall never forget it; better not to know at all."

sentences.zh: 時皆服其量。

translations.literal: All at the time admired his magnanimity.
translations.idiomatic: All present admired his magnanimity.

sentences.zh: 李昉罷相，蒙正拜中書侍郎兼戶部尚書、平章事，監修國史。

translations.literal: When Li Fang left the chief councilorship, Mengzheng was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat concurrently Minister of the Household Bureau and Chief Councilor, and supervised compilation of the National History.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Fang left the chief councilorship, Mengzheng was appointed vice director of the Secretariat concurrently minister of the household bureau and chief councilor, and supervised compilation of the National History.

sentences.zh: 蒙正質厚寬簡，有重望，以正道自持。

translations.literal: Mengzheng was plain, generous, and unpretentious, enjoyed great prestige, and held himself to the upright path.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng was plain, generous, and unpretentious, enjoyed great prestige, and held himself to the upright path.

sentences.zh: 遇事敢言，每論時政，有未允者，必固稱不可，上嘉其無隱。

translations.literal: When matters arose he dared to speak; whenever current policy was discussed, if something was not acceptable he always firmly said it could not be done; the emperor praised his lack of concealment.
translations.idiomatic: When matters arose he spoke boldly; whenever policy was debated, if something was wrong he always firmly said it could not stand, and the emperor praised his frankness.

sentences.zh: 趙普開國元老，蒙正後進，歷官一紀，遂同相位，普甚推許之。

translations.literal: Zhao Pu was a founding elder of the dynasty; Mengzheng was a later arrival, yet after twelve years in office attained the same chief councilorship; Pu greatly approved of him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Pu was a founding elder of the dynasty and Mengzheng a later arrival, yet after twelve years in office Mengzheng reached the same chief councilorship; Pu greatly approved of him.

sentences.zh: 俄丁內艱，起復。

translations.literal: Soon he entered mourning for his mother; he was recalled to office without completing mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he entered mourning for his mother and was recalled to office without completing mourning.

sentences.zh: 先是，盧多遜為相，其子雍起家即授水部員外郎，後遂以為常。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Lu Duoxun was chief councilor, his son Yong upon first entering office was immediately made Vice Director of the Waterworks Bureau; afterward this became customary.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Lu Duoxun was chief councilor, his son Yong upon first entering office was immediately made vice director of the Waterworks Bureau, and afterward this became customary.

sentences.zh: 至是，蒙正奏曰：「臣忝甲科及第，釋褐止授九品京官。

translations.literal: At this time Mengzheng memorialized: "Your subject, though ranked first among jinshi, upon first receiving office was given only a ninth-rank capital post.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Mengzheng memorialized, "Your subject, though ranked first among jinshi, upon first taking office received only a ninth-rank capital post.

sentences.zh: 況天下才能，老於巖穴，不霑寸祿者多矣。

translations.literal: Moreover, men of talent throughout the empire, aging in mountain retreats, who touch not a thread of salary are many.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, many men of talent throughout the empire grow old in mountain retreats without receiving so much as a thread of salary.

sentences.zh: 今臣男始離襁褓，膺此寵命，恐罹陰譴，乞以臣釋褐時官補之。」

translations.literal: Now my son has just left the cradle and receives this favored appointment; I fear attracting hidden reproach and beg that he be given the post I received upon first office."
translations.idiomatic: Now my son has just left the cradle and receives this favored appointment; I fear hidden reproach and beg that he be given the post I received upon first taking office."

sentences.zh: 自是宰相子止授九品京官，遂為定制。

translations.literal: From then on chief councilors' sons received only ninth-rank capital posts; this became established rule.
translations.idiomatic: From then on chief councilors' sons received only ninth-rank capital posts, and this became established rule.

sentences.zh: 朝士有藏古鏡者，自言能照二百里，欲獻之蒙正以求知。

translations.literal: A court gentleman who possessed an antique mirror claimed it could illuminate two hundred li and wished to present it to Mengzheng to gain his notice.
translations.idiomatic: A court gentleman who owned an antique mirror claimed it could illuminate two hundred li and wished to present it to Mengzheng to gain favor.

sentences.zh: 蒙正笑曰：「吾面不過楪子大，安用照二百里哉？」

translations.literal: Mengzheng laughed and said: "My face is no larger than a saucer—what use is illuminating two hundred li?"
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng laughed and said, "My face is no larger than a saucer—what use is a mirror that sees two hundred li?"

sentences.zh: 聞者歎服。

translations.literal: Those who heard it sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: Those who heard it sighed in admiration.

sentences.zh: 淳化中，左正言宋沆上疏忤旨，沆，蒙正妻族，坐是罷為吏部尚書，復相李昉。

translations.literal: In the Chunhua era, Left Direct Remonstrance Song Hang submitted a memorial contrary to the emperor's intent; Hang was of Mengzheng's wife's clan, and for this Mengzheng was removed and made Minister of Personnel; Li Fang was again made chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chunhua era, Left Direct Remonstrance Song Hang submitted a memorial contrary to the emperor's intent; Hang was related to Mengzheng's wife, and for this Mengzheng was removed and made minister of personnel while Li Fang was again made chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 四年，昉罷，蒙正復以本官入相。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Fang left office and Mengzheng again entered the chief councilorship with his former title.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Fang left office and Mengzheng again entered the chief councilorship with his former title.

sentences.zh: 因對，論及征伐，上曰：「朕比來征討，蓋為民除暴，苟好功黷武，則天下之人熸亡盡矣。」

translations.literal: In audience they discussed military campaigns; the emperor said: "My recent expeditions have been to remove tyranny for the people; if one loves merit and abuses arms, then the people of the empire would be utterly extinguished."
translations.idiomatic: In audience they discussed military campaigns; the emperor said, "My recent expeditions have been to remove tyranny for the people; if one loves merit and abuses arms, the people of the empire would be utterly destroyed."

sentences.zh: 蒙正對曰：「隋、唐數十年中，四征遼碣，人不堪命。

translations.literal: Mengzheng replied: "Within several decades of Sui and Tang, they campaigned four times against Liaodong, and the people could not bear the burden.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng replied, "Within several decades of Sui and Tang they campaigned four times against Liaodong, and the people could not bear the burden.

sentences.zh: 煬帝全軍陷沒，太宗自運土木攻城，如此卒無所濟。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang's entire army was destroyed; Emperor Taizong personally hauled earth and timber to assault cities—yet in the end nothing was achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yang's entire army was destroyed; Emperor Taizong of Tang personally hauled earth and timber to assault cities—yet in the end nothing was achieved.

sentences.zh: 且治國之要，在內修政事，則遠人來歸，自致安靜。」

translations.literal: Moreover, the essentials of governing a state lie in improving governance within; then distant peoples will come to submit and quiet will come of itself."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the essentials of governing a state lie in improving governance at home; then distant peoples will come to submit and peace will follow of itself."

sentences.zh: 上韙之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his words.

sentences.zh: 嘗燈夕設宴，蒙正侍，上語之曰：「五代之際，生靈凋喪，周太祖自鄴南歸，士庶皆罹剽掠，下則火災，上則彗孛，觀者恐懼，當時謂無復太平之日矣。

translations.literal: Once at the Lantern Festival a banquet was held; Mengzheng attended, and the emperor said to him: "In the Five Dynasties era, the living were wasted away; when Emperor Taizu of Zhou returned south from Ye, officials and commoners alike suffered pillage; below there were fires, above there were comets—observers were afraid, and at the time people said there would never again be days of peace.
translations.idiomatic: Once at the Lantern Festival a banquet was held; Mengzheng attended, and the emperor said, "In the Five Dynasties era the people were wasted away; when Emperor Taizu of Zhou returned south from Ye, officials and commoners alike suffered pillage; below there were fires, above there were comets, and observers feared there would never again be days of peace.

sentences.zh: 朕躬覽庶政，萬事粗理，每念上天之貺，致此繁盛，乃知理亂在人。」

translations.literal: I personally oversee the myriad affairs of government; all matters are roughly in order; whenever I think of Heaven's gift that has brought this prosperity, I know that order and chaos depend on men."
translations.idiomatic: I personally oversee the myriad affairs of government; all matters are roughly in order; whenever I think of Heaven's gift that has brought this prosperity, I know that order and chaos depend on men."

sentences.zh: 蒙正避席曰：「乘輿所在，士庶走集，故繁盛如此。

translations.literal: Mengzheng left his seat and said: "Where the imperial carriage is, officials and commoners flock together, and so it is prosperous as this.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng left his seat and said, "Where the imperial carriage is, officials and commoners flock together, and so it is prosperous as this.

sentences.zh: 臣嘗見都城外不數里，饑寒而死者甚眾，不必盡然。

translations.literal: Your subject has seen, not a few li outside the capital, many who died of hunger and cold—it is not everywhere so.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject has seen, only a few li outside the capital, many who died of hunger and cold—it is not everywhere so.

sentences.zh: 願陛下視近以及遠，蒼生之幸也。」

translations.literal: I ask Your Majesty to look from the near to the far—that would be the common people's good fortune."
translations.idiomatic: I ask Your Majesty to look from the near to the far—that would be the common people's good fortune."

sentences.zh: 上變色不言。

translations.literal: The emperor changed color and said nothing.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor changed color and said nothing.

sentences.zh: 蒙正侃然復位，同列多其直諒。

translations.literal: Mengzheng composedly resumed his seat; his colleagues admired his frank integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng composedly resumed his seat, and his colleagues admired his frank integrity.

sentences.zh: 上嘗欲遣人使朔方，諭中書選才而可責以事者，蒙正退以名上，上不許。

translations.literal: The emperor once wished to send someone as envoy to Shuofang and ordered the Secretariat to choose a man of talent who could be charged with the task; Mengzheng withdrew and submitted a name, but the emperor did not approve.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once wished to send an envoy to Shuofang and ordered the Secretariat to choose a man of talent who could be charged with the task; Mengzheng withdrew and submitted a name, but the emperor did not approve.

sentences.zh: 他日，三問，三以其人對。

translations.literal: Another day, asked three times, three times he answered with the same man.
translations.idiomatic: On another day the emperor asked three times, and three times Mengzheng named the same man.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「卿何執耶？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Why are you so stubborn?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Why are you so stubborn?"

sentences.zh: 蒙正曰：「臣非執，蓋陛下未諒爾。」

translations.literal: Mengzheng said: "Your subject is not being stubborn—it is simply that Your Majesty has not yet understood."
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng said, "Your subject is not being stubborn—it is simply that Your Majesty has not yet understood."

sentences.zh: 固稱：「其人可使，餘人不及。

translations.literal: He firmly said: "That man can be sent; no one else matches him.
translations.idiomatic: He firmly said, "That man can be sent; no one else matches him.

sentences.zh: 臣不欲用媚道妄隨人主意，以害國事。」

translations.literal: Your subject does not wish to use flattery and recklessly follow another's preference to harm state affairs."
translations.idiomatic: Your subject does not wish to use flattery and recklessly follow another's preference to harm state affairs."

sentences.zh: 同列悚息不敢動。

translations.literal: His colleagues trembled and dared not stir.
translations.idiomatic: His colleagues trembled and dared not stir.

sentences.zh: 上退謂左右曰：「蒙正氣量，我不如。」

translations.literal: The emperor withdrew and said to those around him: "Mengzheng's breadth of spirit—I am not his equal."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor withdrew and said to those around him, "Mengzheng's breadth of spirit—I am not his equal."

sentences.zh: 既而卒用蒙正所薦，果稱職。

translations.literal: In the end he employed the man Mengzheng had recommended, who indeed proved equal to the task.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he employed the man Mengzheng had recommended, who indeed proved equal to the task.

sentences.zh: 至道初，以右僕射出判河南府兼西京留守。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhidao era he left office as Right Vice Director and was assigned to govern Henan Prefecture concurrently as Western Capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhidao era he left office as right vice director and was assigned to govern Henan Prefecture concurrently as Western Capital regent.

sentences.zh: 蒙正至洛，多引親舊歡宴，政尚寬靜，委任僚屬，事多總裁而已。

translations.literal: When Mengzheng reached Luoyang he often invited kin and old friends to merry feasts; his governance favored leniency and quiet; he entrusted matters to his staff and mostly made final decisions only.
translations.idiomatic: When Mengzheng reached Luoyang he often feasted with kin and old friends; his governance favored leniency and quiet, he entrusted affairs to his staff, and mostly made final decisions only.

sentences.zh: 真宗即位，進左僕射。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhenzong ascended the throne, he was promoted to Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong ascended the throne, Mengzheng was promoted to left vice director.

sentences.zh: 會營奉熙陵，蒙正追感先朝不次之遇，奉家財三百餘萬以助用。

translations.literal: When construction was undertaken for Yongxi Mausoleum, Mengzheng, recalling with gratitude the earlier court's extraordinary favor, contributed more than three million in family wealth to assist the work.
translations.idiomatic: When construction was undertaken for Yongxi Mausoleum, Mengzheng, recalling with gratitude the earlier court's extraordinary favor, contributed more than three million in family wealth to assist the work.

sentences.zh: 葬日，伏哭盡哀，人以為得大臣體。

translations.literal: On the burial day he prostrated himself and wept to the full extent of grief; people considered this proper conduct for a great minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the burial day he prostrated himself and wept to the full extent of grief; people considered this proper conduct for a great minister.

sentences.zh: 咸平四年，以本官同平章事、昭文館大學士。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianping he became Chief Councilor with his former title and Grand Academician of the Hall of Broad Culture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianping he became chief councilor with his former title and grand academician of the Hall of Broad Culture.

sentences.zh: 國朝以來三入相者，惟趙普與蒙正焉。

translations.literal: Since the founding of the dynasty, only Zhao Pu and Mengzheng have thrice entered the chief councilorship.
translations.idiomatic: Since the founding of the dynasty, only Zhao Pu and Mengzheng had thrice entered the chief councilorship.

sentences.zh: 郊祀禮成，加司空兼門下侍郎。

translations.literal: When the suburban sacrifice rites were completed, he was added Minister of Works concurrently Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: When the suburban sacrifice rites were completed, he was made minister of works concurrently vice director of the chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六年，授太子太師，封萊國公，改封徐，又封許。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, enfeoffed as Duke of Lai, then changed to Duke of Xu, and again to Duke of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was made grand mentor of the heir apparent, enfeoffed as Duke of Lai, then re-enfeoffed as Duke of Xu, and again as Duke of Xu.

sentences.zh: 景德二年春，表請歸洛。

translations.literal: In spring of the second year of Jingde he submitted a memorial requesting return to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year of Jingde he submitted a memorial requesting return to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 陛辭日，肩輿至東園門，命二子掖以升殿，因言：「遠人請和，弭兵省財，古今上策，惟願陛下以百姓為念。」

translations.literal: On the day of his farewell audience he was carried in a sedan chair to the Eastern Garden Gate; he ordered his two sons to support him up the steps to the hall, and said: "When distant peoples sue for peace, ceasing arms and saving resources is the supreme policy of old and new; I only ask that Your Majesty keep the common people in mind."
translations.idiomatic: On the day of his farewell audience he was carried in a sedan chair to the Eastern Garden Gate, had his two sons support him up the steps to the hall, and said, "When distant peoples sue for peace, ceasing arms and saving resources is the supreme policy of every age; I only ask that Your Majesty keep the common people in mind."

sentences.zh: 上嘉納之，因遷從簡太子洗馬，知簡奉禮郎。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and accepted this; he thereupon promoted Cong Jian to Groom of the Heir Apparent and Zhi Jian to Master of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted this and thereupon promoted Cong Jian to Groom of the Heir Apparent and Zhi Jian to Master of Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 蒙正至洛，有園亭花木，日與親舊宴會，子孫環列，迭奉壽觴，怡然自得。

translations.literal: When Mengzheng reached Luoyang he had gardens, pavilions, and flowers; daily he feasted with kin and old friends; his sons and grandsons ranged around him, each in turn offering cups of longevity wine; he was content and at ease.
translations.idiomatic: When Mengzheng reached Luoyang he had gardens, pavilions, and flowers; daily he feasted with kin and old friends; his sons and grandsons ranged around him, each in turn offering cups of longevity wine, and he was content and at ease.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符而後，上朝永熙陵，封泰山，祠后土，過洛，兩幸其第，錫賚有加。

translations.literal: After the Dazhong Xiangfu era, when the emperor went to pay court at Yongxi Mausoleum, performed the fengshan at Mount Tai, and sacrificed to Earth at Hou Tu, passing through Luoyang he twice visited Mengzheng's mansion and bestowed gifts beyond the usual.
translations.idiomatic: After the Dazhong Xiangfu era, when the emperor went to pay court at Yongxi Mausoleum, performed the fengshan at Mount Tai, and sacrificed to Earth, passing through Luoyang he twice visited Mengzheng's mansion and bestowed extraordinary gifts.

sentences.zh: 上謂蒙正曰：「卿諸子孰可用？」

translations.literal: The emperor said to Mengzheng: "Among your sons, which can be employed?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to Mengzheng, "Among your sons, which can be employed?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「諸子皆不足用。

translations.literal: He replied: "None of my sons is adequate.
translations.idiomatic: He replied, "None of my sons is adequate.

sentences.zh: 有侄夷簡，任潁州推官，宰相才也。」

translations.literal: I have a nephew, Yijian, serving as judicial investigator in Ying Prefecture—he has the talent of a chief councilor."
translations.idiomatic: I have a nephew, Yijian, serving as judicial investigator in Ying Prefecture—he has the talent of a chief councilor."

sentences.zh: 夷簡由是見知於上。

translations.literal: Yijian was thereby noticed by the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Yijian was thereby noticed by the emperor.

sentences.zh: 富言者，蒙正客也。

translations.literal: Fu Yan was Mengzheng's retainer.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yan was Mengzheng's retainer.

sentences.zh: 一日白曰：「兒子十許歲，欲令入書院，事廷評、太祝。」

translations.literal: One day he reported: "My son is about ten years old; I wish to have him enter the academy and serve as court reviewer and grand invocator."
translations.idiomatic: One day he reported, "My son is about ten years old; I wish to have him enter the academy and serve as court reviewer and grand invocator."

sentences.zh: 蒙正許之。

translations.literal: Mengzheng agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng agreed.

sentences.zh: 及見，驚曰：「此兒他日名位與吾相似，而勳業遠過於吾。」

translations.literal: When he saw the boy he exclaimed: "This child will one day hold rank and title similar to mine, yet his achievements will far surpass mine."
translations.idiomatic: When he saw the boy he exclaimed, "This child will one day hold rank and title similar to mine, yet his achievements will far surpass mine."

sentences.zh: 令與諸子同學，供給甚厚。

translations.literal: He had him study together with his own sons and provided for him very generously.
translations.idiomatic: He had him study together with his own sons and provided for him very generously.

sentences.zh: 言之子，即弼也。

translations.literal: Yan's son was Bi—that is, Fu Bi.
translations.idiomatic: Yan's son was Bi—that is, Fu Bi.

sentences.zh: 後弼兩入相，亦以司徒致仕。

translations.literal: Later Bi twice entered the chief councilorship and also retired as Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: Later Bi twice entered the chief councilorship and also retired as minister over the masses.

sentences.zh: 其知人類如此。

translations.literal: His discernment of men was of this sort.
translations.idiomatic: His discernment of men was of this sort.

sentences.zh: 許國之命甫下而卒，年六十八。

translations.literal: The appointment as Duke of Xu had just been issued when he died, aged sixty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: The appointment as Duke of Xu had just been issued when he died, aged sixty-eight.

sentences.zh: 贈中書令，諡曰文穆。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Director of the Secretariat; his posthumous title was Wenmu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made director of the Secretariat and given the posthumous title Wenmu.

sentences.zh: 蒙正初為相時，張紳知蔡州，坐贓免。

translations.literal: When Mengzheng first became chief councilor, Zhang Shen was prefect of Cai Prefecture and was dismissed for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: When Mengzheng first became chief councilor, Zhang Shen was prefect of Cai Prefecture and was dismissed for corruption.

sentences.zh: 或言於上曰：「紳家富，不至此，特蒙正貧時勾索不如意，今報之爾。」

translations.literal: Someone told the emperor: "Shen's family is wealthy and would not have come to this; it is simply that when Mengzheng was poor Shen's demands for payment were unsatisfactory, and now he is repaying him."
translations.idiomatic: Someone told the emperor, "Shen's family is wealthy and would not have come to this; it is simply that when Mengzheng was poor Shen's demands for payment were unsatisfactory, and now he is repaying him."

sentences.zh: 上命即復紳官，蒙正不辯。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that Shen's office be immediately restored; Mengzheng did not argue.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that Shen's office be immediately restored; Mengzheng did not argue.

sentences.zh: 後考課院得紳實狀，復黜為絳州團練副使。

translations.literal: Later the Evaluation Bureau obtained the facts of Shen's case and he was again dismissed and made deputy military training commissioner of Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Evaluation Bureau obtained the facts of Shen's case and he was again dismissed and made deputy military training commissioner of Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 及蒙正再入相，太宗謂曰：「張紳果有贓。」

translations.literal: When Mengzheng again entered the chief councilorship, Emperor Taizong said to him: "Zhang Shen truly had corrupt gains."
translations.idiomatic: When Mengzheng again entered the chief councilorship, Emperor Taizong said to him, "Zhang Shen truly had corrupt gains."

sentences.zh: 蒙正不辯亦不謝。

translations.literal: Mengzheng neither argued nor thanked him.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng neither argued nor thanked him.

sentences.zh: 在西京日，上數遣中貴人將命至，蒙正待之如在相位時，不少貶，時人重焉。

translations.literal: During his days in the Western Capital the emperor repeatedly sent palace eunuchs bearing orders; Mengzheng received them as when he was chief councilor, without any lowering of regard; people of the time respected this.
translations.idiomatic: During his days in the Western Capital the emperor repeatedly sent palace eunuchs bearing orders; Mengzheng received them as when he was chief councilor, without any lessening of regard, and people of the time respected this.

sentences.zh: 子從簡，再為國子博士；

translations.literal: His son Cong Jian again served as Erudite of the Directorate of Education;
translations.idiomatic: His son Cong Jian again served as an erudite of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 惟簡，太子中舍；

translations.literal: Wei Jian, Palace Aide in the Household of the Heir Apparent;
translations.idiomatic: Wei Jian was a palace aide in the household of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 承簡，司門員外郎；

translations.literal: Cheng Jian, Vice Director in the Gate Department;
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Jian was vice director in the Gate Department.

sentences.zh: 行簡，比部員外郎；

translations.literal: Xing Jian, Vice Director in the Audit Bureau;
translations.idiomatic: Xing Jian was vice director in the Audit Bureau.

sentences.zh: 務簡，亦國子博士；

translations.literal: Wu Jian, also Erudite of the Directorate of Education;
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jian also served as an erudite of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 居簡，殿中丞；

translations.literal: Ju Jian, Vice Director in the Palace Reception;
translations.idiomatic: Ju Jian was vice director in the Palace Reception.

sentences.zh: 知簡，太子右讚善大夫。

translations.literal: Zhi Jian, Right Administrative Aide in the Household of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi Jian was right administrative aide in the household of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 蒙正弟蒙休，咸平進士，至殿中丞。

translations.literal: Mengzheng's younger brother Mengxiu, a jinshi of the Xianping era, rose to Vice Director in the Palace Reception.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzheng's younger brother Mengxiu, a jinshi of the Xianping era, rose to vice director in the Palace Reception.

sentences.zh: 龜圖弟龜祥，殿中丞、知壽州。

translations.literal: Qitu's younger brother Guixiang, Vice Director in the Palace Reception and prefect of Shou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Qitu's younger brother Guixiang served as vice director in the Palace Reception and prefect of Shou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 子蒙亨，舉進士高等，既廷試，以蒙正居中書，故報罷。

translations.literal: His son Mengheng ranked high in the jinshi examination; after the palace examination, because Mengzheng was in the chief council, he was rejected.
translations.idiomatic: His son Mengheng ranked high in the jinshi examination, but after the palace examination he was rejected because Mengzheng was serving in the chief council.

sentences.zh: 後歷下蔡、武平主簿。

translations.literal: Later he served successively as registrar of Xiaocai and Wuping.
translations.idiomatic: He later served successively as registrar of Xiaocai and Wuping.

sentences.zh: 至道初，考課州縣官，蒙亨引對，文學、政事俱優，命為光祿寺丞，改大理寺丞，卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhidao era, when county and prefectural officials were evaluated, Mengheng was summoned for audience; both literary accomplishment and administrative performance were outstanding; he was appointed Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, transferred to Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, and died.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhidao era, when county and prefectural officials were evaluated, Mengheng was summoned for audience and proved outstanding in both literary and administrative performance. He was appointed vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, transferred to vice director of the Court of Judicial Review, and died in office.

sentences.zh: 次子蒙巽，虞部員外郎；

translations.literal: The second son, Mengxun, Vice Director in the Bureau of Forestry and Crafts;
translations.idiomatic: The second son, Mengxun, was vice director in the Bureau of Forestry and Crafts.

sentences.zh: 蒙周，淳化進士及第。

translations.literal: Mengzhou passed the jinshi examination in the Chunhua era.
translations.idiomatic: Mengzhou passed the jinshi examination in the Chunhua era.

sentences.zh: 蒙亨子即夷簡也。

translations.literal: Mengheng's son was Yijian.
translations.idiomatic: Mengheng's son was Yijian.

sentences.zh: 次子宗簡，亦進士及第。

translations.literal: The second son, Zong Jian, also passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: The second son, Zong Jian, also passed the jinshi examination.

sentences.zh: 慶曆中，居簡提點京東刑獄，時夏竦有憾於石介，介死，竦言於上曰：「介未嘗死，北走鄰國矣。」

translations.literal: During the Qingli era, Ju Jian was judicial intendant of Jingdong Circuit. At that time Xia Song bore a grudge against Shi Jie. When Jie died, Song told the emperor: "Jie never died; he fled north to a neighboring state."
translations.idiomatic: During the Qingli era, Ju Jian served as judicial intendant of Jingdong Circuit. At that time Xia Song bore a grudge against Shi Jie. When Jie died, Song told the emperor, "Jie never died; he fled north to a neighboring state."

sentences.zh: 乃遣中使發棺驗之。

translations.literal: The emperor then sent a palace envoy to open the coffin and verify.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then sent a palace envoy to open the coffin and verify.

sentences.zh: 居簡謂曰：「萬一介果死，則朝廷為無故發人之墓，奈何？」

translations.literal: Ju Jian said: "If by chance Jie is indeed dead, then the court will for no reason have opened a man's tomb—what then?"
translations.idiomatic: Ju Jian said, "If by chance Jie is indeed dead, the court will have opened a man's tomb for no reason. What then?"

sentences.zh: 中使曰：「於君何如？」

translations.literal: The palace envoy said: "What about you in this?"
translations.idiomatic: The palace envoy said, "What about you in this?"

sentences.zh: 居簡曰：「介死，當時必有內外親族及門生會葬，問之可也。」

translations.literal: Ju Jian said: "If Jie died, there would surely have been kin inside and outside the family and his students at the burial; one could simply ask them."
translations.idiomatic: Ju Jian said, "If Jie died, there would surely have been relatives and students at the burial. One could simply ask them."

sentences.zh: 中使乃令結狀保證以聞，介事乃白。

translations.literal: The palace envoy then had written guarantees sworn and reported up; the matter concerning Jie was thereby cleared.
translations.idiomatic: The palace envoy then had written guarantees sworn and reported up, and the matter concerning Jie was cleared.

sentences.zh: 居簡長者，其行事多類此。

translations.literal: Ju Jian was a man of mature judgment; many of his actions were of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: Ju Jian was a man of mature judgment, and many of his actions were of this kind.

sentences.zh: 徐州妖人孔直溫挾左道誘軍士為變，或詣轉運使告，不受詞。

translations.literal: At Xuzhou, the sorcerer Kong Zhiwen used heterodox arts to lure soldiers into mutiny; someone went to the transport commissioner to report it, but the complaint was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: At Xuzhou the sorcerer Kong Zhiwen used heterodox arts to lure soldiers into mutiny. Someone reported it to the transport commissioner, but the complaint was not accepted.

sentences.zh: 居簡令易其牒，盡捕究黨與，貸詿誤者，請於朝，斬直溫等。

translations.literal: Ju Jian had the document re-filed, arrested and investigated all accomplices, pardoned those who had been misled, requested orders from the court, and had Zhiwen and others executed.
translations.idiomatic: Ju Jian had the report re-filed, arrested and investigated all accomplices, pardoned those who had been misled, sought orders from the court, and had Zhiwen and others executed.

sentences.zh: 濮州復叛，都民驚潰，居簡馳往，獲首惡誅之。

translations.literal: When Puzhou rebelled again, the capital people panicked and scattered; Ju Jian rushed there, captured the ringleader, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Puzhou rebelled again, the people of the prefectural capital panicked and scattered. Ju Jian rushed there, captured the ringleader, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 因大閱兵享勞，姦不得發。

translations.literal: He then held a grand review of troops and feasted them in reward, so no further mischief could break out.
translations.idiomatic: He then held a grand review of troops and feasted them in reward, so no further mischief could break out.

sentences.zh: 用二事，遷秩鹽鐵判官，拜集賢院學士、知梓州、應天府，徙荊南，進龍圖閣直學士、知廣州，陶甓甃城，人以為便。

translations.literal: For these two achievements he was promoted to Salt and Iron Commissioner, appointed Academician in the Academy of Scholarly Worthies and prefect of Zizhou and Yingtian Prefecture, transferred to Jingnan, advanced to Draft Academician of the Longtu Hall and prefect of Guangzhou; he paved the city walls with fired tiles, which people regarded as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: For these two achievements he was promoted to salt and iron commissioner, appointed academician in the Academy of Scholarly Worthies and prefect of Zizhou and Yingtian Prefecture, transferred to Jingnan, and advanced to draft academician of the Longtu Hall and prefect of Guangzhou. He paved the city walls with fired tiles, which people found convenient.

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎判西京御史臺，卒，年七十二。

translations.literal: As Vice Minister of War he served as chief of the Western Capital Censorate; he died at seventy-two.
translations.idiomatic: As vice minister of war he served as chief of the Western Capital Censorate and died at seventy-two.

sentences.zh: 張齊賢

translations.literal: Zhang Qixian
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qixian

sentences.zh: 張齊賢，曹州冤句人。

translations.literal: Zhang Qixian was a man of Yuanqu in Cao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qixian was a native of Yuanqu in Cao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 生三歲，值晉亂，徙家洛陽。

translations.literal: At age three, amid the chaos of Jin, his family moved to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: At the age of three, amid the chaos of the Jin dynasty, his family moved to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 孤貧力學，有遠志，慕唐李大亮之為人，故字師亮。

translations.literal: Orphaned and poor, he studied diligently; he had far-reaching ambition and admired the character of Tang's Li Daliang, and therefore took the style Shiliang.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned and poor, he studied diligently. He had far-reaching ambition, admired the character of Tang's Li Daliang, and therefore took the style Shiliang.

sentences.zh: 太祖幸西都，齊賢以布衣獻策馬前，召至行宮，齊賢以手畫地，條陳十事：曰下幷、汾、曰富民、曰封建、曰敦孝、曰舉賢、曰太學、曰籍田、曰選良吏、曰慎刑、曰懲姦。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taizu visited the Western Capital, Qixian as a commoner presented a memorial before the emperor's horse; summoned to the temporary palace, Qixian traced on the ground with his hand and set forth ten items in order: annexing Bing and Fen; enriching the people; enfeoffment; promoting filial piety; elevating the worthy; the Imperial Academy; the ceremonial plowing field; selecting good officials; cautious punishment; punishing wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taizu visited the Western Capital, Qixian, as a commoner, presented a memorial before the emperor's horse. Summoned to the temporary palace, he traced on the ground with his hand and set forth ten items in order: annexing Bing and Fen, enriching the people, enfeoffment, promoting filial piety, elevating the worthy, the Imperial Academy, the ceremonial plowing field, selecting good officials, cautious punishment, and punishing wickedness.

sentences.zh: 內四說稱旨，齊賢堅執以為皆善，上怒，令武士拽出之。

translations.literal: Four of his points pleased the emperor, but Qixian stubbornly maintained that all were good; the emperor grew angry and ordered warriors to drag him out.
translations.idiomatic: Four of his points pleased the emperor, but Qixian stubbornly maintained that all were good. The emperor grew angry and ordered warriors to drag him out.

sentences.zh: 及還，語太宗曰：「我幸西都，唯得一張齊賢爾。

translations.literal: When he returned, he told Emperor Taizong: "On my visit to the Western Capital I gained only one Zhang Qixian.
translations.idiomatic: When he returned, he told Emperor Taizong, "On my visit to the Western Capital I gained only one Zhang Qixian.

sentences.zh: 我不欲爵之以官，異時可使輔汝為相也。」

translations.literal: I do not wish to ennoble him with office now; in time you may have him assist you as chief councilor."
translations.idiomatic: I do not wish to ennoble him with office now; in time you may have him assist you as chief councilor."

sentences.zh: 太宗擢進士，欲置齊賢高第，有司偶失掄選，上不悅，一榜盡與京官，於是齊賢以大理評事通判衡州。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taizong elevated jinshi, he wished to place Qixian in the top rank, but the office mishandled the selection; the emperor was displeased and gave the entire list capital offices; Qixian thus became Judicial Reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review and supervising prefect of Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taizong elevated jinshi, he wished to place Qixian in the top rank, but the office mishandled the selection. The emperor was displeased and gave the entire list capital offices, so Qixian became judicial reviewer in the Court of Judicial Review and supervising prefect of Heng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時州鞫劫盜，論皆死，齊賢至，活其失入者五人。

translations.literal: At the time the prefecture was trying bandits and robbers, and all were sentenced to death; when Qixian arrived, he spared five who had been wrongly implicated.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the prefecture was trying bandits and robbers, and all were sentenced to death. When Qixian arrived, he spared five who had been wrongly implicated.

sentences.zh: 自荊渚至桂州，水遞鋪夫數千戶，困於郵役，衣食多不給，論奏減其半。

translations.literal: From Jing's embankments to Guizhou, several thousand households of water relay couriers were strained by postal service and often could not supply food and clothing; he memorialized and had the burden reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: From Jing's embankments to Guizhou, several thousand households of water relay couriers were strained by postal service and often could not supply food and clothing. He memorialized and had the burden reduced by half.

sentences.zh: 四年，代還，會親征晉陽，齊賢上謁，遷秘書丞。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he returned upon replacement of office; when the emperor personally campaigned against Jinyang, Qixian presented himself and was promoted to Secretary of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he returned upon replacement of office. When the emperor personally campaigned against Jinyang, Qixian presented himself and was promoted to secretary of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 忻州新下，命知州事。

translations.literal: When Xin Prefecture had newly fallen, he was ordered to administer prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Xin Prefecture had newly fallen, he was ordered to administer prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 明年召還，改著作佐郎，直史館，改左拾遺。

translations.literal: The next year he was recalled and made Assistant in the Bureau of Compilation, entered duty at the Historiography Office, and was changed to Left Reminder.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was recalled, made assistant in the Bureau of Compilation, entered duty at the Historiography Office, and was changed to left reminder.

sentences.zh: 冬，車駕北征，議者皆言宜速取幽薊，齊賢上疏曰：

translations.literal: In winter the imperial carriage went north on campaign; debaters all said it was best to seize You and Ji quickly; Qixian submitted a memorial saying:
translations.idiomatic: In winter the imperial carriage went north on campaign. Debaters all said it was best to seize You and Ji quickly. Qixian submitted a memorial saying:

sentences.zh: 「方今海內一家，朝野無事。

translations.literal: "At present within the seas all is one family, and court and countryside are without disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: "At present within the seas all is one family, and court and countryside are without disturbance.

sentences.zh: 關聖慮者，豈不以河東新平，屯兵尚眾，幽燕未下，輦運為勞？

translations.literal: What fills the sage mind with concern—is it not that east of the river has only newly been pacified, troops remain numerous, You and Yan are not yet taken, and transport by cart is exhausting?
translations.idiomatic: What fills the sage mind with concern—is it not that east of the river has only newly been pacified, troops remain numerous, You and Yan are not yet taken, and transport by cart is exhausting?

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為此不足慮也。

translations.literal: Your subject foolishly believes this is not worth worrying over.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject foolishly believes this is not worth worrying over.

sentences.zh: 自河東初下，臣知忻州，捕得契丹納米典吏，皆云自山後轉般以授河東。

translations.literal: From when east of the river was first taken, when I was prefect of Xin, we captured Khitan grain-collection clerks who all said grain was transferred from beyond the mountains to supply east of the river.
translations.idiomatic: From when east of the river was first taken, when I was prefect of Xin, we captured Khitan grain-collection clerks who all said grain was transferred from beyond the mountains to supply east of the river.

sentences.zh: 以臣料，契丹能自備軍食，則於太原非不盡力，然終為我有者，力不足也。

translations.literal: By my reckoning, if the Khitan could supply their own army provisions, they would not have failed to do their utmost at Taiyuan; yet in the end it became ours because their strength was insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: By my reckoning, if the Khitan could supply their own army provisions, they would not have failed to do their utmost at Taiyuan. Yet in the end it became ours because their strength was insufficient.

sentences.zh: 河東初平，人心未固，嵐、憲、忻、代未有軍砦，入寇則田牧頓失，擾邊則守備可虞。

translations.literal: When east of the river was first pacified, hearts were not yet firm; Lan, Xian, Xin, and Dai had no military stockades; if invaded, fields and herds would at once be lost; if the border were harassed, defenses would be doubtful.
translations.idiomatic: When east of the river was first pacified, hearts were not yet firm. Lan, Xian, Xin, and Dai had no military stockades. If invaded, fields and herds would at once be lost; if the border were harassed, defenses would be doubtful.

sentences.zh: 及國家守要害，增壁壘，左控右扼，疆事甚嚴，恩信已行，民心已定，乃於雁門陽武谷來爭小利，此其智力可料而知也。

translations.literal: When the state holds key positions and strengthens ramparts, controlling left and blocking right, frontier affairs are very strict, benevolence and trust have been applied, and popular hearts are settled—then for them to come to Yang Gate and Yangwu Valley to fight over small gains, their intelligence and strength can be calculated and known.
translations.idiomatic: When the state holds key positions and strengthens ramparts, controlling left and blocking right, frontier affairs are very strict, benevolence and trust have been applied, and popular hearts are settled, then for them to come to Yang Gate and Yangwu Valley to fight over small gains—their intelligence and strength can be calculated and known.

sentences.zh: 聖人舉事，動在萬全，百戰百勝，不若不戰而勝，若重之慎之，則契丹不足吞，燕薊不足取。

translations.literal: When the sage undertakes affairs, his actions are in every case secure; though victorious in a hundred battles, better still is victory without fighting. If treated with weight and caution, the Khitan need not be swallowed, and You and Ji need not be taken.
translations.idiomatic: When the sage undertakes affairs, his actions are in every case secure. Though victorious in a hundred battles, better still is victory without fighting. If treated with weight and caution, the Khitan need not be swallowed, and You and Ji need not be taken.

sentences.zh: 自古疆埸之難，非盡由敵國，亦多邊吏擾而致之。

translations.literal: Since antiquity border difficulties have not all been caused by enemy states; often frontier officials by harassment have brought them about.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity border difficulties have not all been caused by enemy states; often frontier officials by harassment have brought them about.

sentences.zh: 若緣邊諸砦撫御得人，但使峻壘深溝，畜力養銳，以逸自處，寧我致人，此李牧所以用趙也。

translations.literal: If the various stockades along the border are well governed and defended, keeping only high ramparts and deep ditches, storing strength and nurturing keenness, resting at ease—better that I should move against others—this is how Li Mu used Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: If the various stockades along the border are well governed and defended, keeping only high ramparts and deep ditches, storing strength and nurturing keenness, and resting at ease—better that I should move against others—this is how Li Mu used Zhao.

sentences.zh: 所謂擇卒不如擇將，任力不如任人。

translations.literal: What is called choosing soldiers is not as good as choosing generals; relying on force is not as good as relying on men.
translations.idiomatic: What is called choosing soldiers is not as good as choosing generals; relying on force is not as good as relying on men.

sentences.zh: 如是則邊鄙寧，邊鄙寧則輦運減，輦運減則河北之民獲休息矣。

translations.literal: If so, the frontier will be secure; if the frontier is secure, cart transport will diminish; if cart transport diminishes, the people of Hebei will gain rest.
translations.idiomatic: If so, the frontier will be secure; if the frontier is secure, cart transport will diminish; if cart transport diminishes, the people of Hebei will gain rest.

sentences.zh: 民獲休息，則田業增而蠶績廣，務農積穀，以實邊用。

translations.literal: When the people gain rest, then farming will increase and silk production expand; cultivate agriculture and accumulate grain to solidify frontier needs.
translations.idiomatic: When the people gain rest, farming will increase and silk production expand. Cultivate agriculture and accumulate grain to solidify frontier needs.

sentences.zh: 且敵人之心固亦擇利避害，安肯投諸死地而為寇哉？

translations.literal: Moreover the hearts of the enemy also surely choose profit and avoid harm—how would they willingly throw themselves into dead ground to become raiders?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the hearts of the enemy also surely choose profit and avoid harm. How would they willingly throw themselves into dead ground to become raiders?

sentences.zh: 臣聞家六合者以天下為心，豈止爭尺寸之事，角強弱之勢而已乎？

translations.literal: Your subject has heard that one who embraces the six directions takes the empire as his heart—is it only about contesting inches of territory and measuring strength against weakness?
translations.idiomatic: Your subject has heard that one who embraces the six directions takes the empire as his heart—is it only about contesting inches of territory and measuring strength against weakness?

sentences.zh: 是故聖人先本而後末，安內以養外。

translations.literal: Therefore the sage first attends to the root and afterward to the branches, securing the interior to nurture the exterior.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the sage first attends to the root and afterward to the branches, securing the interior to nurture the exterior.

sentences.zh: 人民，本也，疆土，末也。

translations.literal: The people are the root; territory is the branch.
translations.idiomatic: The people are the root; territory is the branch.

sentences.zh: 五帝三王，未有不先根本者也。

translations.literal: The Five Emperors and Three Kings—there is none who did not first attend to the root.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Emperors and Three Kings—there is none who did not first attend to the root.

sentences.zh: 堯、舜之道無他，在乎安民而利之爾。

translations.literal: The way of Yao and Shun has nothing else to it; it lies in securing the people and benefiting them.
translations.idiomatic: The way of Yao and Shun has nothing else to it; it lies in securing the people and benefiting them.

sentences.zh: 民既安利，則遠人斂衽而至矣。

translations.literal: When the people are secured and benefited, then distant people will draw up their sleeves and come.
translations.idiomatic: When the people are secured and benefited, distant peoples will draw up their sleeves and come.

sentences.zh: 陛下愛民人、利天下之心，真堯、舜也。

translations.literal: Your Majesty's heart to love the people and benefit the empire is truly that of Yao and Shun.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's heart to love the people and benefit the empire is truly that of Yao and Shun.

sentences.zh: 臣慮群臣多以纖微之利，克下之術，侵苦窮民，以為功能。

translations.literal: Your subject fears that many ministers focus on minute profit, techniques of prevailing over subordinates, oppressing and afflicting the destitute people, and take this as accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject fears that many ministers focus on minute profit, techniques of prevailing over subordinates, oppressing and afflicting the destitute people, and take this as accomplishment.

sentences.zh: 至於生民疾苦，見之如不見，聞之如不聞，斂怨速尤，無大於此。

translations.literal: As for the suffering of the living people, they see yet do not see, hear yet do not hear—nothing gathers resentment and hastens blame more than this.
translations.idiomatic: As for the suffering of the living people, they see yet do not see, hear yet do not hear—nothing gathers resentment and hastens blame more than this.

sentences.zh: 伏望慎擇通儒，分路采訪兩浙、江南、荊湖、西川、嶺南、河東，凡前日賦斂苛重者，改而正之，因而利之，使賦稅課利通濟，可經久而行，為聖朝定法；

translations.literal: I humbly hope you will carefully choose broadly learned scholars, sending them by separate routes to visit and investigate the Two Zhe, Jiangnan, Jinghu, Sichuan, Lingnan, and east of the river; wherever earlier levies and collections were harsh and heavy, reform and correct them, and thereby bring benefit; so that tax levies and commercial duties flow without obstruction and can be maintained long, establishing law for the holy court;
translations.idiomatic: I humbly hope you will carefully choose broadly learned scholars and send them by separate routes to visit and investigate the Two Zhe, Jiangnan, Jinghu, Sichuan, Lingnan, and east of the river. Wherever earlier levies and collections were harsh and heavy, reform and correct them and thereby bring benefit, so that tax levies and commercial duties flow without obstruction and can be maintained long, establishing law for the holy court.

sentences.zh: 除去舊弊，天下諸州有不便於民者，委長吏以聞。

translations.literal: Remove old abuses; throughout the empire's prefectures where anything inconveniences the people, let senior officials report it.
translations.idiomatic: Remove old abuses. Throughout the empire's prefectures, wherever anything inconveniences the people, let senior officials report it.

sentences.zh: 敢循故常者，重置之法。

translations.literal: Whoever dares follow old practice shall face severe penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever dares follow old practice shall face severe penalty.

sentences.zh: 使天下耳目皆知陛下之心，戴陛下之惠，以德懷遠，以惠利民，則遠人之歸，可立而待也。」

translations.literal: Let all under heaven's eyes and ears know Your Majesty's heart and receive Your Majesty's grace; with virtue cherish the distant, with bounty benefit the people—then the return of distant peoples can be awaited standing."
translations.idiomatic: Let all under heaven's eyes and ears know Your Majesty's heart and receive Your Majesty's grace. With virtue cherish the distant, with bounty benefit the people, and the return of distant peoples can be awaited standing."

sentences.zh: 六年，為江南西路轉運副使，冬，改右補闕，加正使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was Deputy Transport Commissioner of Jiangnan West Circuit; in winter he was changed to Right Supplementation Aide and made chief commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was deputy transport commissioner of Jiangnan West Circuit. In winter he was changed to right supplementation aide and made chief commissioner.

sentences.zh: 齊賢至官，詢知饒、信、虔州土產銅、鐵、鉛、錫之所，推求前代鑄法，取饒州永平監所鑄以為定式，歲鑄五十萬貫，凡用銅八十五萬斤，鉛三十六萬斤，錫十六萬斤，詣闕面陳其事，敷奏詳確，議者不能奪。

translations.literal: When Qixian took office he inquired and learned where Rao, Xin, and Qian prefectures produced copper, iron, lead, and tin; he investigated former dynasties' minting methods, took the Yongping Directorate of Rao's casting as the fixed standard, casting five hundred thousand strings per year, using in all eight hundred fifty thousand jin of copper, three hundred sixty thousand jin of lead, and one hundred sixty thousand jin of tin; he went to court and presented the matter in person, reporting in detail; debaters could not overturn him.
translations.idiomatic: When Qixian took office he inquired and learned where Rao, Xin, and Qian prefectures produced copper, iron, lead, and tin. He investigated former dynasties' minting methods, took the Yongping Directorate of Rao's casting as the fixed standard, and cast five hundred thousand strings per year, using in all eight hundred fifty thousand jin of copper, three hundred sixty thousand jin of lead, and one hundred sixty thousand jin of tin. He went to court and presented the matter in person, reporting in detail, and debaters could not overturn him.

sentences.zh: 先是，諸州罪人多錮送闕下，路死者十常五六。

translations.literal: Previously, convicts from various prefectures were often shackled and sent to the capital; on the road one or two in five or six often died.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, convicts from various prefectures were often shackled and sent to the capital, and on the road one or two in five or six often died.

sentences.zh: 齊賢道逢南劍、建昌、虔州所送，索牒視之，率非首犯，悉伸其冤抑。

translations.literal: Qixian on the road encountered those sent from Nanjian, Jianchang, and Qian prefectures; he demanded the documents and looked at them—almost none were principal offenders—and fully vindicated their wrongful suffering.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian on the road encountered prisoners sent from Nanjian, Jianchang, and Qian prefectures. He demanded the documents and looked at them; almost none were principal offenders, and he fully vindicated their wrongful suffering.

sentences.zh: 因力言於朝，後凡送囚至京，請委強明吏慮問，不實，則罪及原問官屬。

translations.literal: He therefore vigorously spoke in court; afterward whenever prisoners were sent to the capital, they requested able and clear officials to examine them; if not substantiated, the original questioning officials would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore vigorously spoke in court. Afterward, whenever prisoners were sent to the capital, able and clear officials were requested to examine them, and if the charges were not substantiated, the original questioning officials would be punished.

sentences.zh: 自是江南送罪人者為減太半。

translations.literal: From this, those sent from Jiangnan as convicts were reduced by more than half.
translations.idiomatic: From this, prisoners sent from Jiangnan to the capital were reduced by more than half.

sentences.zh: 先是，江南諸州小民，居官地者有地房錢，吉州緣江地雖淪沒，猶納勾欄地錢，編木而浮居者名水場錢，皆前代弊政，齊賢悉論免之。

translations.literal: Previously, common people in various prefectures of Jiangnan who lived on official land paid land-house money; in Ji Prefecture along the river, though land was submerged they still paid corral land money; those who floated dwellings on rafts were called water station money—all abuses of former dynasties; Qixian memorialized and had all exempted.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, common people in various prefectures of Jiangnan who lived on official land paid land-house money. In Ji Prefecture along the river, though land was submerged they still paid corral land money, and those who floated dwellings on rafts paid water station money—all abuses of former dynasties. Qixian memorialized and had all exempted.

sentences.zh: 初，李氏據有江南，民戶稅錢三千已上者戶出丁一人，黥面，自備器甲輸官庫，出即給之，日支糧二升，名為義軍。

translations.literal: At first, when the Li house held Jiangnan, households paying three thousand cash or more in tax supplied one man per household, tattooed on the face, furnished their own armor into the state storehouse, and when deployed it was issued to them; two sheng of grain per day, called righteous army.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when the Li house held Jiangnan, households paying three thousand cash or more in tax supplied one man per household, tattooed on the face, furnished their own armor into the state storehouse, and when deployed it was issued to them, with two sheng of grain per day. They were called righteous armies.

sentences.zh: 既內附，皆放歸農。

translations.literal: After submitting to the interior, all were released to return to farming.
translations.idiomatic: After submitting to the interior, all were released to return to farming.

sentences.zh: 至是，言者以為此輩久在行伍，不樂耕農，乞遣使選充軍伍，並其家屬送闕下。

translations.literal: At this time memorializers thought these men had long been in the ranks and did not enjoy farming; they requested envoys be sent to select them for military service and send them with their families to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: At this time memorializers thought these men had long been in the ranks and did not enjoy farming. They requested that envoys be sent to select them for military service and send them with their families to the capital.

sentences.zh: 齊賢上言：「江南義軍，例皆良民，橫遭黥配，無所逃避。

translations.literal: Qixian submitted: "The righteous armies of Jiangnan are in every case good common people, forcibly tattooed and assigned, with no escape.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian submitted, "The righteous armies of Jiangnan are in every case good common people, forcibly tattooed and assigned, with no escape.

sentences.zh: 克復之後，便放歸農，久被皇風，並皆樂業。

translations.literal: After recovery they were at once released to farming; long bathed in the imperial wind, all delight in their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: After recovery they were at once released to farming. Long bathed in the imperial wind, all delight in their occupations.

sentences.zh: 若逐戶搜索，不無驚擾。

translations.literal: If household by household they are searched out, there will inevitably be alarm and disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: If household by household they are searched out, there will inevitably be alarm and disturbance.

sentences.zh: 法貴有常，政尚清淨，前敕既放營農，不若且仍舊貫。」

translations.literal: Law values constancy; government prefers purity and tranquility; since the prior edict already released them to camp farming, better for now to keep the old practice."
translations.idiomatic: Law values constancy; government prefers purity and tranquility. Since the prior edict already released them to camp farming, it is better for now to keep the old practice."

sentences.zh: 齊賢居使職，勤究民弊，務行寬大，江左人思之不忘。

translations.literal: When Qixian held commissioner office, he diligently investigated popular abuses, striving to practice leniency; people of Jiangzuo remember him and do not forget.
translations.idiomatic: When Qixian held commissioner office, he diligently investigated popular abuses and strove to practice leniency. People of Jiangzuo remember him and do not forget.

sentences.zh: 召還，拜樞密直學士，擢右諫議大夫、簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Recalled, he was appointed Draft Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, promoted to Right Remonstrance and Grand Councilor and signed at the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he was appointed draft academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, promoted to right remonstrance and grand councilor, and signed at the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 雍熙初，遷左諫議大夫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongxi he was promoted to Left Remonstrance and Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yongxi he was promoted to left remonstrance and councilor.

sentences.zh: 三年，大舉北伐，代州楊業戰沒。

translations.literal: In the third year a great northern campaign was launched; Yang Ye of Dai Prefecture died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year a great northern campaign was launched, and Yang Ye of Dai Prefecture died in battle.

sentences.zh: 上訪近臣以策，齊賢請行，即授給事中、知代州，與部署潘美同領緣邊兵馬。

translations.literal: The emperor consulted close ministers for strategy; Qixian requested to go and was at once appointed Supervising Attendant and prefect of Dai Prefecture, jointly leading frontier troops and horses with Deployment Commissioner Pan Mei.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor consulted close ministers for strategy. Qixian requested to go and was at once appointed supervising attendant and prefect of Dai Prefecture, jointly leading frontier troops and horses with deployment commissioner Pan Mei.

sentences.zh: 是時遼兵自湖谷入寇，薄城下，神衛都校馬正以所部列南門外，眾寡不敵，副部署盧漢贇畏懦，保壁自固。

translations.literal: At that time Liao troops entered through Hugu Valley to raid, pressing to the foot of the city; Shenwei Commander Ma Zheng drew up his troops outside the south gate; they were too few to match the enemy; Deputy Deployment Commissioner Lu Hanyun was timid and cowardly, securing the walls and holding himself fast.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liao troops entered through Hugu Valley to raid, pressing to the foot of the city. Shenwei Commander Ma Zheng drew up his troops outside the south gate, but they were too few to match the enemy. Deputy deployment commissioner Lu Hanyun was timid and cowardly, securing the walls and holding himself fast.

sentences.zh: 齊賢選廂軍二千，出正之右，誓眾慷慨，一以當百，遼兵遂卻。

translations.literal: Qixian selected two thousand garrison troops, went out to Ma Zheng's right, vowed to the masses with passionate zeal, each man matching a hundred; the Liao troops then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian selected two thousand garrison troops, went out to Ma Zheng's right, and vowed to the masses with passionate zeal, each man matching a hundred. The Liao troops then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 先是，約潘美以幷師來會戰，無何，間使為遼人所得。

translations.literal: Previously they had agreed that Pan Mei would join forces from Bing to meet in battle; before long, a secret messenger was captured by the Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Previously they had agreed that Pan Mei would join forces from Bing to meet in battle. Before long, a secret messenger was captured by the Liao.

sentences.zh: 齊賢以師期既漏，且虞美眾為遼所乘。

translations.literal: Qixian thought the campaign schedule had leaked, and feared Mei's army would be exploited by the Liao.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian thought the campaign schedule had leaked and feared Mei's army would be exploited by the Liao.

sentences.zh: 既而美使至，云師出并州，至柏井，得密詔，東師敗績於君子館，幷之全軍不許出戰，已還州矣。

translations.literal: Soon Mei's messenger arrived, saying the army had left Bing Prefecture, reached Baijing, received a secret edict: the eastern army had been defeated at Junzi Pavilion; Bing's entire army was forbidden to go out to fight and had already returned to the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Mei's messenger arrived, saying the army had left Bing Prefecture and reached Baijing, where it received a secret edict: the eastern army had been defeated at Junzi Pavilion, Bing's entire army was forbidden to go out to fight, and had already returned to the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 於時遼兵塞川，齊賢曰：「賊知美之來，而不知美之退。」

translations.literal: At that time Liao troops filled the valleys; Qixian said: "The bandits know Mei is coming but do not know Mei has withdrawn."
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liao troops filled the valleys. Qixian said, "The bandits know Mei is coming but do not know Mei has withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 乃閉其使密室，中夜發兵二百，人持一幟，負一束芻，距州城西南三十里，列幟然芻。

translations.literal: He then shut their messenger in a secret room; at midnight he sent out two hundred soldiers, each man holding one banner and carrying one bundle of fodder; thirty li southwest of the prefectural city they set up banners and burned fodder.
translations.idiomatic: He then shut their messenger in a secret room. At midnight he sent out two hundred soldiers, each man holding one banner and carrying one bundle of fodder. Thirty li southwest of the prefectural city they set up banners and burned fodder.

sentences.zh: 遼兵遙見火光中有旗幟，意謂幷師至矣，駭而北走。

translations.literal: The Liao troops from afar saw banners in the firelight and thought Bing's army had arrived; terrified, they fled north.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao troops from afar saw banners in the firelight and thought Bing's army had arrived. Terrified, they fled north.

sentences.zh: 齊賢先伏步兵二千於土磴砦，掩擊大敗之，擒其北大王之子一人，帳前錫利一人，斬數百級，獲馬二千、器甲甚眾。

translations.literal: Qixian had first hidden two thousand foot soldiers at Tudeng Stockade; they struck from cover and routed them completely, capturing one son of the Northern Great King and one Xili before the tent, beheading several hundred, seizing two thousand horses and a great quantity of armor and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian had first hidden two thousand foot soldiers at Tudeng Stockade. They struck from cover and routed the enemy completely, capturing one son of the Northern Great King and one Xili before the tent, beheading several hundred, seizing two thousand horses and a great quantity of armor and weapons.

sentences.zh: 捷奏，且歸功漢贇。

translations.literal: He reported the victory and also credited Hanyun.
translations.idiomatic: He reported the victory and also credited Hanyun.

sentences.zh: 二年，置屯田，領河東制置方田都部署，入拜刑部侍郎、樞密副使。

translations.literal: In the second year he established military colonies, headed the Hedong Directorate for Field-Allotment Settlements Chief Deployment, and entered court as Vice Minister of Justice and Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he established military colonies and headed the Hedong directorate for field-allotment settlements chief deployment, then entered court as vice minister of justice and vice commissioner of the bureau of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 淳化二年夏，參知政事，數月，拜吏部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In summer of the second year of Chunhua he became Vice Director of the Secretariat-Chancellery; after several months he was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel and Concurrent Manager of Affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Chunhua 2 he became vice director of the secretariat-chancellery, and after several months was appointed vice minister of personnel and concurrent manager of affairs with the secretariat-chancellery.

sentences.zh: 齊賢母孫氏年八十餘，封晉國太夫人，每入謁禁中，上歎其福壽、有令子，多手詔存問，加賜與，搢紳榮之。

translations.literal: Qixian's mother, Lady Sun, was over eighty; she was enfeoffed as Grand Lady of Jin. Whenever she entered the palace to pay respects, the emperor sighed at her good fortune and longevity and at having an excellent son, often sending personal edicts to inquire after her and granting additional gifts. Court officials regarded this as an honor.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian's mother, Lady Sun, was over eighty and was enfeoffed as grand lady of Jin. Whenever she entered the palace to pay respects, the emperor sighed at her good fortune, longevity, and excellent son, often sending personal edicts to inquire after her and granting additional gifts. Court officials regarded this as a great honor.

sentences.zh: 初，王延德與朱貽業同掌京庾，欲求補外，貽業與參政李沆有姻婭，託之以請於沆，沆為請於齊賢，齊賢以聞。

translations.literal: Earlier, Wang Yande and Zhu Yiye jointly managed the capital granaries and wished to obtain outside appointments. Yiye was related by marriage to Vice Director Li Hang and asked him to request this of Hang; Hang made the request of Qixian, and Qixian reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Wang Yande and Zhu Yiye jointly managed the capital granaries and wished to obtain outside appointments. Yiye was related by marriage to Vice Director Li Hang and asked him to intercede; Hang made the request of Qixian, and Qixian reported it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 太宗以延德嘗事晉邸。

translations.literal: Taizong, because Yande had once served in the household of the Prince of Jin,
translations.idiomatic: Because Yande had once served in the household of the Prince of Jin, Taizong

sentences.zh: 怒其不自陳而干祈執政，召見詰責。

translations.literal: was angry that he had not stated his case himself but had importuned the chief ministers, summoned him for an audience, and interrogated and rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: was angry that he had not stated his case himself but had importuned the chief ministers. He summoned Yande for an audience and interrogated and rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 延德、貽業皆諱不以實對，齊賢不欲累沆，獨任其責。

translations.literal: Yande and Yiye both evaded giving truthful answers. Qixian, unwilling to implicate Hang, alone accepted responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Yande and Yiye both evaded giving truthful answers. Unwilling to implicate Hang, Qixian alone accepted responsibility.

sentences.zh: 四年六月，罷為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year he was dismissed and made Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fourth year he was dismissed and made left assistant director of the department of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月，命知定州，以母老不願往，未幾，丁內艱，水漿不入口者七日，自是日啖粥一器，終喪不食酒肉蔬果。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he was ordered to serve as prefect of Ding Prefecture, but because his mother was old he did not wish to go. Before long he entered mourning for his mother; for seven days he took no water or food, and thereafter ate one bowl of gruel daily. Throughout the mourning period he ate no wine, meat, or vegetables.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he was ordered to serve as prefect of Ding Prefecture, but because his mother was old he did not wish to go. Before long he entered mourning for his mother and for seven days took no water or food; thereafter he ate one bowl of gruel daily. Throughout the mourning period he consumed no wine, meat, or vegetables.

sentences.zh: 尋復轉禮部尚書、知河南府。

translations.literal: Soon he was again transferred to Minister of Rites and prefect of Henan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was again transferred to minister of rites and prefect of Henan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時獄有大辟將決，齊賢至，立辨而釋之。

translations.literal: At the time a capital case was about to be decided; when Qixian arrived he immediately distinguished the facts and released the prisoner.
translations.idiomatic: At the time a capital case was about to be decided; when Qixian arrived he immediately distinguished the facts and released the prisoner.

sentences.zh: 三日，徙知永興軍。

translations.literal: Three days later he was transferred to serve as prefect of Yongxing Army.
translations.idiomatic: Three days later he was transferred to serve as prefect of Yongxing Army.

sentences.zh: 時閣門祗候趙讚以言事得幸，提點關中芻糧，所為多豪橫。

translations.literal: At the time Ceremonial Gateway Attendant Zhao Zan, who had gained favor by memorializing on affairs of state, was intendant of Guanzhong fodder and grain; his conduct was largely overbearing and violent.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Ceremonial Gateway Attendant Zhao Zan, who had gained favor by memorializing on affairs of state, was intendant of Guanzhong fodder and grain, and his conduct was largely overbearing and violent.

sentences.zh: 齊賢論列其罪，卒抵於法。

translations.literal: Qixian enumerated his crimes, and in the end he was punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian enumerated his crimes, and in the end Zhao Zan was punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 俄徙襄州，移荊南，又徙安州。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to Xiang Prefecture, then to Jingnan, and again to An Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was transferred to Xiang Prefecture, then to Jingnan, and again to An Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 逾年，加刑部尚書。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was promoted to Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he was promoted to minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 四年，李繼遷陷清遠軍，命為涇、原等州軍安撫經略使，以右司諫梁顥為之副。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Li Jiqian captured Qingyuan Army. Qixian was appointed Commissioner for Appeasement and Military Strategy of Jing, Yuan, and other prefectures and armies, with Right Remonstrance Official Liang Hao as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, after Li Jiqian captured Qingyuan Army, Qixian was appointed commissioner for appeasement and military strategy of Jing, Yuan, and other prefectures and armies, with Right Remonstrance Official Liang Hao as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 齊賢上言謂：「清遠軍陷沒以來，青岡砦燒棄之後，靈武一郡，援隔勢孤，此繼遷之所覬覦而必至者也。

translations.literal: Qixian submitted a memorial saying: "Since Qingyuan Army fell and Qinggang Stockade was burned and abandoned, Lingwu Prefecture alone has been cut off from support and stands isolated. This is what Jiqian covets and is certain to reach.
translations.idiomatic: Qixian submitted a memorial saying, "Since Qingyuan Army fell and Qinggang Stockade was burned and abandoned, Lingwu Prefecture alone has been cut off from support and stands isolated. This is what Jiqian covets and is certain to reach.

sentences.zh: 以事勢言之，加討則不足，防遏則有餘。

translations.literal: Judging by the situation, to launch a punitive campaign would be insufficient, but to defend and block would be more than enough.
translations.idiomatic: Judging by the situation, launching a punitive campaign would be insufficient, but defending and blocking would be more than enough.

sentences.zh: 其計無他，蕃部大族首領素與繼遷有隙者，若能啖以官爵，誘以貨利，結之以恩信，而激之以利害，則山西之蕃部族帳，靡不傾心朝廷矣。

translations.literal: The plan is nothing else: among the great tribal clans and chieftains of the frontier peoples who have long been at odds with Jiqian, if one can entice them with office and rank, lure them with goods and profit, bind them with grace and trust, and spur them with advantage and harm, then the frontier tribal encampments west of the mountains will all incline their hearts to the court.
translations.idiomatic: The plan is otherwise simple: among the great frontier tribal clans and chieftains who have long been at odds with Jiqian, if one can entice them with office and rank, lure them with goods and profit, bind them with grace and trust, and spur them with advantage and harm, then the frontier tribal encampments west of the mountains will all incline their hearts to the court.

sentences.zh: 臣所領十二州軍，見二萬餘人，若緣邊料柬本城等軍，更得五萬餘人，招致蕃部，其數又逾十數萬。

translations.literal: The twelve prefectures and armies under my command currently have more than twenty thousand men; if along the border one selects troops from the local garrison armies and the like, another fifty thousand or more can be obtained, and if frontier tribes are recruited their numbers would exceed several hundred thousand more.
translations.idiomatic: The twelve prefectures and armies under my command currently have more than twenty thousand men. If troops are selected from border garrisons and the like, another fifty thousand or more can be obtained, and if frontier tribes are recruited their numbers would exceed several hundred thousand more.

sentences.zh: 但彼出則我歸，東備則西擊，使之奔走不暇，何能為我患哉？

translations.literal: But when they go out we withdraw, when they guard the east we strike the west, making them rush about without rest—how could they become a threat to us?
translations.idiomatic: But when they go out we withdraw; when they guard the east we strike the west, making them rush about without rest. How could they become a threat to us?

sentences.zh: 今靈武軍民不翅六七萬，陷於危亡之地，若繼遷來春於我兵未舉之前，發兵救援靈武，盡驅其眾，並力攻圍，則靈州孤城必難固守。

translations.literal: Now the soldiers and people of Lingwu Army number no less than sixty or seventy thousand, trapped in a place of peril and ruin.
